analysis: The host run succeeded, completing training and independent evaluation in 284.16 allocated GPU-seconds. Macro validation HR@10 was 0.475: Movies_and_TV 0.480, Industrial_and_Scientific 0.515, Electronics 0.385, and CDs_and_Vinyl 0.520. Electronics was the weakest category. The score exceeds the code’s stated parent reference of 0.4313 by 0.0437, but trails its SASRec reference of 0.505 by 0.0300. Successful completion confirms that this version passed its runtime and predictor checks; it does not establish the earlier crash’s cause or isolate which change improved performance.
code_summary: Trains a separate attentive similarity model for each of four dataset routes. Separate history and target embeddings feed candidate-conditioned attention with learned recency bucket biases and square-root normalization. Two causal Transformer blocks add contextual history features through a learned gate initialized to zero. Training uses random chronological prefixes, history truncation and dropout, 16 sampled negatives, cross-entropy, embedding regularization, AdamW, and gradient clipping. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG as a tie-breaker. The emitted predictor reconstructs the saved architecture, strictly loads parameters, and scores candidates in chunks of 256. Predictor checks now use matching chunk sizes; exceptions are saved under working/training_error.log, and the validation score is printed last.
